title: July 2018 only
text:
Not sure what I expected but a bit of a let down. Canceled and probably won’t renew
1) Deadpool riding a unicorn extra large pop is fun and I like that.
2) Taco truck taco holder. I will probably enjoy using it but it looks like it’s from a dollar store (plus who needs just 1 sad lonely taco holder)
3) Deadpool pop style luggage tag. Actually useful.
4) Deadpool blind bag keychain. I got plain Deadpool with big gaps between misaligned pieces
No T-shirt (which I probably wouldn’t wear)
I think they should stick to limits pops not that the taco holder and luggage label were bad additions but it felt like discount store filler.
I enjoy a good mystery box but so far all I’ve tried are just junk I don’t need or want.
label: neutral
